identity.encoding: SHA256 over sorted regular nonsymlink src/spec relative path + NUL + per-file SHA256 hex + newline
identity.command: ruby -rjson -rdigest -e 'files = Dir.glob("{src,spec}/**/*").select { |p| File.file?(p) && !File.symlink?(p) }.sort; digest = Digest::SHA256.new; files.each { |p| digest.update(p + "\0" + Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest + "\n") }; puts JSON.generate(files: files.size, sha256: digest.hexdigest)'
